```{python}
# Map issue labels based on state of review package is in.
label_map = {
    "pre-review": [
        "New Submission!", 
        "0/pre-review-checks"],
    "seeking editor": ["0/seeking-editor"],
    "seeking reviewers": ["2/seeking-reviewers"],
    "under-review": [
        "1/editor-assigned",
        "3/reviewers-assigned",
        "4/reviews-in-awaiting-changes",
        "5/awaiting-reviewer-response",
    ],
    "accepted-open": ["6/pyOS-approved", "9/joss-approved"],
}

def get_active_status(labels):
    """A function that returns an active status value based on a list of label values"""
    for status, label_list in label_map.items():
        if any(label in labels for label in label_list):
            return status
    return "unknown"


def show_submissions(df):
    """Show a submission table with package names linked to their issues."""
    issue_column = df.columns.get_loc("Issue")
    name_column = df.columns.get_loc("Name")
    link_renderer = itables.JavascriptFunction(
        f"""
        function(data, type, row) {{
            if (type !== "display") return data;

            const link = document.createElement("a");
            link.href = `https://github.com/pyOpenSci/software-submission/issues/${{row[{issue_column}]}}`;
            link.textContent = data;
            link.target = "_blank";
            link.rel = "noopener noreferrer";
            return link.outerHTML;
        }}
        """
    )
    return show(
        df,
        showIndex=False,
        columnDefs=[{"targets": name_column, "render": link_renderer}],
    )


```

```{python}
#| output: false
def categorize_status(status):
    if status in ["under-review", "seeking editor", "seeking reviewers"]:
        return "Under Review"
    elif status == "pre-review":
        return "Pre-Review"
    elif status == "accepted-open":
        return "Accepted Open"
    return "Other"

review_status_ct["grouped_status"] = review_status_ct["active_status"].apply(categorize_status)
grouped_status_ct = review_status_ct.groupby("grouped_status", as_index=False)["count"].sum()
only_active = grouped_status_ct[grouped_status_ct["grouped_status"] != "Accepted Open"]
```

## Row {height=auto}

:::: {.card title="Editor load"}
Next, we look at the load of each editor over time to get a sense of their time demands.

::: {.callout-note}
Review counts by quarter for the last two years. This includes every editor who led a review in that window, not only people with a review open right now.
:::

```{python}
#| output: false
end_year = datetime.now(timezone.utc).year
YEARS = [str(end_year - 1), str(end_year)]
QUARTERS = ["Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"]

name_by_user = (
    editor_data.dropna(subset=["gh_username"])
    .assign(first_name=lambda frame: frame["first_name"].fillna(frame["gh_username"]))
    .set_index("gh_username")["first_name"]
    .to_dict()
)

def editor_title(editor):
    return name_by_user.get(editor, editor)

edits = reviews[["editor", "Name", "Date Opened"]].rename(
    columns={"Date Opened": "Date", "Name": "package_name"}
)
edits = edits[
    edits["editor"].notna() & (edits["editor"].astype(str).str.upper() != "TBD")
]
edits["editor"] = edits["editor"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
edits["Date"] = pd.to_datetime(edits["Date"], utc=True)
edits["Year"] = edits["Date"].dt.year.astype(str)
edits = edits[edits["Year"].isin(YEARS)]
edits["Quarter"] = "Q" + edits["Date"].dt.quarter.astype(str)

editors = sorted(edits["editor"].unique())
full_index = pd.MultiIndex.from_product(
    [editors, YEARS, QUARTERS],
    names=["editor", "Year", "Quarter"],
)
quarter_df = (
    edits.groupby(["editor", "Year", "Quarter"])
    .size()
    .reindex(full_index, fill_value=0)
    .reset_index(name="count")
)

def review_count_by_quarter_fig(df):
    """Small-multiple quarterly bars, same layout as the editorial dashboard."""
    editors = sorted(df["editor"].unique(), key=lambda editor: editor_title(editor).lower())
    titles = [editor_title(editor) for editor in editors]
    n_cols = 3
    n_rows = max(1, (len(editors) + n_cols - 1) // n_cols)
    n_periods = len(YEARS) * len(QUARTERS)
    tickvals = list(range(n_periods))
    ticktext = QUARTERS * len(YEARS)
    year_centers = [
        i * len(QUARTERS) + (len(QUARTERS) - 1) / 2 for i in range(len(YEARS))
    ]
    y_max = max(3, int(df["count"].max()) if len(df) else 3)

    fig = make_subplots(
        rows=n_rows,
        cols=n_cols,
        subplot_titles=titles,
        vertical_spacing=0.12,
        horizontal_spacing=0.06,
    )
    for i, editor in enumerate(editors):
        sub = df[df["editor"] == editor].copy()
        sub["Year"] = pd.Categorical(sub["Year"], categories=YEARS, ordered=True)
        sub["Quarter"] = pd.Categorical(sub["Quarter"], categories=QUARTERS, ordered=True)
        sub = sub.sort_values(["Year", "Quarter"])
        row = i // n_cols + 1
        col = i % n_cols + 1
        fig.add_trace(
            go.Bar(
                x=list(range(n_periods)),
                y=sub["count"].tolist(),
                marker_color="indigo",
                showlegend=False,
                customdata=sub[["Year", "Quarter"]].astype(str).to_numpy(),
                hovertemplate="%{customdata[0]} %{customdata[1]}: %{y}<extra></extra>",
            ),
            row=row,
            col=col,
        )
        axis_num = i + 1
        xref = "x" if axis_num == 1 else f"x{axis_num}"
        yref = "y" if axis_num == 1 else f"y{axis_num}"
        for year, xc in zip(YEARS, year_centers):
            fig.add_annotation(
                x=xc,
                y=-0.28,
                xref=xref,
                yref=f"{yref} domain",
                text=year,
                showarrow=False,
                font=dict(size=10),
                yanchor="top",
            )

    fig.update_xaxes(
        tickvals=tickvals,
        ticktext=ticktext,
        tickfont=dict(size=9),
        title_text="",
        range=[-0.5, n_periods - 0.5],
        showgrid=False,
        zeroline=False,
        ticks="outside",
        ticklen=3,
    )
    fig.update_yaxes(
        dtick=1,
        tickformat=",d",
        title_text="Review count",
        range=[0, y_max],
        zeroline=False,
    )
    fig.update_layout(
        title=f"Editor review count by quarter ({YEARS[0]}–{YEARS[-1]})",
        title_font_size=24,
        height=260 * n_rows,
        margin=dict(t=80, b=40),
        showlegend=False,
        bargap=0.2,
    )
    fig.for_each_annotation(
        lambda ann: ann.update(font=dict(size=16)) if ann.text in titles else ann
    )
    return fig
```

```{python}
review_count_by_quarter_fig(quarter_df).show()
```
